registered_before: any v2 build or v2 measurement run

v2_changes.arms: the cross's six arms become relation groups — isa / prop / use+can / loc / part+madeof+has / causes+sub+needs+want — each keeping its 4 heaviest facets (6 arms x 4 faces = 24, the structure's own capacity used AS structure instead of as a flat bucket). AtLocation can no longer crowd out properties.
v2_changes.question_gate: a 「XはYですか」 property question reads every arm EXCEPT loc — a place answers where, never whether. If the surviving arms hold nothing, that is UNKNOWN_NO_EVIDENCE (refusal), not an answer.

unchanged: thresholds: adopt if correct >= 18 and wrong <= 2, else park
one_shot: v2 is measured ONCE. If it parks, the sovereign stays parked and further redesigns need their own registration and a stated reason this is not threshold-shopping. Both v1 and v2 results are reported wherever either is cited.
